title: Proving grounds
summary: Proving Grounds is a long fan fiction work, posted in installments in 1994, that forms part of the Future Imperfect cycle of the Undocumented Features series. The story is set in the twenty-fourth century and follows a small group of characters as the galaxy changes around them. Its central figure is R-Type, a GENOM executive and researcher whose company's military division has been broken up and whose former loyalties are being tested. The narrative moves between his corporate life, a cyberspace raid on an Internet control node, and a visit to Titan with the legendary pilot Gryphon, who is travelling with his partner Kei and their newborn daughter. Later sections follow R-Type's personal relationship with Yuri, a meeting that deepens into a soul-bond. The authors describe the work as sprawling, deliberately rambling, and concerned with growth and the way times change people. The text is a mix of science fiction, cyberpunk-style hacking, and multiple media-universe crossovers, and it ends with the note that this is Part One.
